title: Ao Bing’s Little Boat
author: Peihong Guo

en.title: Ao Bing’s Little Boat
en.description: Wukong and Ao Bing want to give a little leaf a boat ride, but their clay ball sinks. Plop! No dragon magic: they change its shape instead. A flat pancake sinks too, but pinch up the edges and the hollow boat floats! Same clay, new shape.

zh.title: 敖丙的小船，浮起来！
zh.description: 悟空和敖丙想让小叶子坐船，可黏土球“咚”地沉了下去。不用龙的魔法，他们来改变形状：压扁的煎饼船也沉了，把边捏高、中间空空的小船却浮起来了！还是同一团黏土，只是换了形状。

description: 悟空和敖丙想让小叶子坐船，可黏土球“咚”地沉了下去。不用龙的魔法，他们来改变形状：压扁的煎饼船也沉了，把边捏高、中间空空的小船却浮起来了！还是同一团黏土，只是换了形状。

title: Princess Iron Fan’s Pattern Parade
title_zh: 铁扇公主的彩旗小麻烦
author: Peihong Guo

en.title: Princess Iron Fan’s Pattern Parade
en.description: Princess Iron Fan hangs flags for a little parade: red, red, gold, again and again. Wukong hurries, and one group comes out wrong! With claps and stomps, the friends check one group at a time, fix the pattern, and march: step, step, swish!

zh.title: 铁扇公主的彩旗小麻烦
zh.description: 铁扇公主要办小游行，彩旗按红、红、金一组一组地重复。悟空一着急，挂错了一面！大家拍手、跺脚，一组一组地检查，把规律修好，最后踏、踏、甩，一起去游行。

description: 铁扇公主要办小游行，彩旗按红、红、金一组一组地重复。悟空一着急，挂错了一面！大家拍手、跺脚，一组一组地检查，把规律修好，最后踏、踏、甩，一起去游行。

title: Pigsy’s Nine Little Cookies
author: Peihong Guo

en.title: Pigsy’s Nine Little Cookies
en.description: Pigsy bakes nine little cookies to share with Wukong and Rabbit. Wukong deals them out four, three, two. Not fair! So they share in turns, one for each plate, round and round. After three rounds everyone has three, and three plates are enough.

zh.title: 八戒的九块小饼干
zh.description: 八戒烤了九块小饼干，要和悟空、玉兔一起分。悟空分成四块、三块、两块——不公平！大家改成轮流分，每只盘子放一块，一轮一轮地分。分完三轮，每人三块，三只盘子刚刚好。

description: 八戒烤了九块小饼干，要和悟空、玉兔一起分。悟空分成四块、三块、两块——不公平！大家改成轮流分，每只盘子放一块，一轮一轮地分。分完三轮，每人三块，三只盘子刚刚好。

title: Nezha’s Shape Town
author: Peihong Guo

en.title: Nezha’s Shape Town
en.description: Nezha’s paper town needs one more square window, but only two blue triangles are left. Wukong wears them as a pointy hat, then Rabbit shows how turning them makes the long sides fit — a square! The same two pieces make a big triangle too.

zh.title: 哪吒的形状小镇
zh.description: 哪吒的纸小镇还缺一扇方窗户，盒子里却只剩两块蓝色三角形。悟空先把它们当成尖尖的帽子，玉兔教大家转一转，长边一对上就拼成了方块！同样两块还能拼成一个大三角形。

title: Wukong and the Copycat Shadow
author: Peihong Guo

en.title: Wukong and the Copycat Shadow
en.description: At shadow-show night, Wukong thinks a giant copycat is following him. Rabbit shows him it is his shadow: he blocks the light. Nearer the lamp, a puppet’s shadow grows big; farther away, it shrinks. And when the lamp goes off, the copycat goes home.

zh.title: 悟空的跟屁虫影子
zh.description: 院子里演影子戏，悟空以为有个大个子在学他。玉兔告诉他，那是他的影子：他挡住了光。纸偶离灯近，影子就变大；离灯远，影子就变小。灯一关，学他的朋友也回家了。

title: Wukong Wants to Play Too
author: Peihong Guo

en.title: Wukong Wants to Play Too
en.description: Pigsy, Rabbit and Ao Bing are rolling a ball in a circle. Wukong wants to play so much that he runs in and grabs it. Sandy shows him another way: look, ask, wait. Soon there is room in the circle for everyone.

zh.title: 悟空想一起玩
zh.description: 八戒、玉兔和敖丙围成一圈玩滚球。悟空太想一起玩，一下冲进去把球抱住了。沙僧教他换一种办法：看一看，问一问，等一等。很快，圆圈里就有了每个人的位置。

title: Wukong Visits the Dentist
author: Peihong Guo

en.title: Wukong Visits the Dentist
en.description: Wukong visits the dentist with Sandy. The chair goes up like a little cloud, but the bzzz sounds like a big bee! The dentist promises to stop whenever he raises his hand — and she does. Wukong asks, gets ready, and goes home with a new toothbrush.

zh.title: 悟空看牙医
zh.description: 沙僧陪悟空去看牙医。牙椅像小云朵一样升起来，可是“嗡嗡”声好像大蜜蜂！牙医阿姨说，想停就举手，她真的停了下来。悟空问清楚、准备好，最后还带回一把新牙刷。

title: Wukong Visits the Pumpkin Patch
author: Peihong Guo

en.title: Wukong Visits the Pumpkin Patch
en.description: Wukong, Ao Bing and Nezha head into a corn maze on the way to the pumpkin field. Nezha dashes ahead and they pop out back at the start, so they look for clues: left at the scarecrow, right at the pumpkins, straight ahead — and a pumpkin each to take home.

zh.title: 悟空逛南瓜农场
zh.description: 悟空、敖丙和哪吒走进通往南瓜田的玉米迷宫。哪吒冲在前面，结果又绕回了入口。大家改成找路上的标记：到了稻草人往左拐，到了南瓜堆往右拐，一直往前走，最后每人都挑到一个南瓜。

title: Wukong’s Little Dinosaur Halloween
author: Peihong Guo

en.title: Wukong’s Little Dinosaur Halloween
en.description: Wukong has a brand-new dinosaur costume and a big, loud ROAR. But when a tiny hedgehog opens the first door, Wukong finds a softer way to say trick or treat. Ring the bell, take one, say thank you — and share with a friend.

zh.title: 悟空的小恐龙万圣夜
zh.description: 悟空穿上新的恐龙装，练了一声大大的“嗷——呜！”。可第一家开门的是一只小小的刺猬，悟空换成小小声的“嗷呜”。按门铃、只拿一颗、说谢谢，回家还把糖分给陪他走了一路的沙僧。

title: Wukong’s Starry Stage
author: Peihong Guo

en.title: Wukong’s Starry Stage
en.description: Wukong sets up a little stage for story night. Six paper stars, then two more from Rabbit — eight altogether. The entrance needs some too, so they take away three: five are left on the curtain, but still eight altogether. And Pigsy has an idea for the moon.

zh.title: 悟空的星星小剧场
zh.description: 悟空要办故事会，在幕布上贴了六颗纸星星，玉兔又带来两颗，一共八颗。入口也想要星星，他们从幕布上拿走三颗：幕布上还剩五颗，合起来还是八颗。八戒还想用自己的圆肚子当月亮呢！

description: 悟空要办故事会，在幕布上贴了六颗纸星星，玉兔又带来两颗，一共八颗。入口也想要星星，他们从幕布上拿走三颗：幕布上还剩五颗，合起来还是八颗。八戒还想用自己的圆肚子当月亮呢！

title: Big Cards, Little Numbers
author: Peihong Guo

en.title: Big Cards, Little Numbers
en.description: Nezha paints a big card with a 3 and a small card with a 5. Wukong is sure the big card wins, until Rabbit’s beads show that five is more than three. Big card or small card, the number tells how many.

zh.title: 大纸牌，小数字
zh.description: 哪吒画了一张写着3的大卡片和一张写着5的小卡片。悟空觉得大卡片一定赢，可玉兔用木珠一摆，五颗比三颗多。卡片大也好，小也好，数字告诉我们有几个。

title: Princess Iron Fan’s Ribbon Parade
author: Peihong Guo

en.title: Princess Iron Fan’s Ribbon Parade
en.description: Princess Iron Fan plans a ribbon parade. Wukong’s rolled-up ribbon looks shortest, then he tries a sneaky start. Lined up at the same line, the ribbons go short, longer, longest.

zh.title: 铁扇公主的彩带游行
zh.description: 铁扇公主要办彩带游行。悟空的红彩带卷成一团，看起来最短，他又想偷偷往前挪。大家把彩带从同一条线开始摆好，才看清短的、长一些的和最长的。

title: Pigsy’s Peach Puzzle
author: Peihong Guo

en.title: Pigsy’s Peach Puzzle
en.description: Pigsy is sure three big peaches are more than five small ones. Wukong and Rabbit line them up in pairs to compare, and Pigsy finds out: big or small, one peach is one peach.

zh.title: 八戒的桃子谜题
zh.description: 八戒觉得三个大桃子一定比五个小桃子多。悟空和玉兔把桃子一对一对排好来比，八戒终于明白：不管大还是小，一个桃子就是一个。

title: Wukong and the Block Bridge
author: Peihong Guo

en.title: Wukong and the Block Bridge
en.description: The toy train needs a bridge over a blue cloth river. Wukong and Ao Bing measure with different blocks and disagree, until Pigsy brings blocks of the same size: end to end, no gaps, the river is four blocks wide.

zh.title: 悟空的积木小桥
zh.description: 小火车要过一条蓝布小河。悟空和敖丙用不一样的积木量，说法不一样；八戒拿来一样大的积木，一块挨一块不留空，量出河有四块积木那么宽，再找到合适的木板搭成小桥。

title: Wukong’s Missing Picnic Cup
author: Peihong Guo

en.title: Wukong’s Missing Picnic Cup
en.description: Wukong sets out cups for his picnic friends: one, two, three, four. But when he sits down, his own hands are empty! Counting again, everyone finds the friend he forgot: Wukong himself.

zh.title: 悟空少算了谁？
zh.description: 悟空给野餐的朋友们摆杯子：一、二、三、四。可他自己坐下来，手里却空空的！大家再数一数，原来他少算了一个朋友——就是他自己。

title: Wukong Visits the Aquarium
author: Peihong Guo

en.title: Wukong Visits the Aquarium
en.description: Wukong visits an aquarium with Ao Bing and Sandy. He watches kelp, a hiding fish, jellyfish, and a sea otter, then draws three favorites on his card.

author: Peihong Guo

en.title: Wukong’s Brick-Building Day
en.description: Wukong and his friends build a brick castle together, solving a tricky doorway problem and making room for everyone.

zh.title: 悟空的积木城堡
zh.description: 悟空和朋友们一起搭积木城堡。他们想办法解决门口太窄的问题，让大家都能进来。

title: Wukong Learns to Swim
author: Peihong Guo

en.title: Wukong Learns to Swim
en.description: Wukong is curious about swimming, but the pool feels big. With Coach Otter nearby and Ao Bing cheering him on, he practices bubbles, floating, and kicks until he swims a little way on his own.
